# proxmox_node_ceph_pool (Resource)

Manages a Ceph pool through `/nodes/{node}/ceph/pool`. Import as `<node>/<name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_ceph_pool" "p" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  name     = "rbd"
  size     = 3
  min_size = 2
  pg_num   = 64
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Pool name.
- `node` (String) Cluster node used for the API call.

### Optional

- `min_size` (Number) Minimum replicas for writes.
- `pg_autoscale_mode` (String) Autoscale mode: `on`, `off` or `warn`.
- `pg_num` (Number) Placement group count.
- `pg_num_min` (Number) Lower autoscaler bound.
- `size` (Number) Replica count.

### Read-Only

- `crush_rule_name` (String) CRUSH rule of the pool.
- `id` (String) Identifier in `<node>/<name>` form.
- `percent_used` (Number) Used capacity in percent.
